description:
Preview what delete_sub_account would do to one sub-account, without changing anything: the counts the dashboard Delete sub-account dialog shows and the sub-account that would take its place, or why deletion is refused (allowed: false). Needs profiles:read; a key bound to a sub-account previews only its own.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: preview_profile_deletion

new_primary.description: Named when the deleted sub-account is (or was) the primary: the OLDEST remaining sub-account takes over, and messages sent without choosing a sub-account carry its name.
